header.title: DNS over HTTPS (DoH) Prober
header.description: Real-time client-side DNS resolution probe benchmarking multi-resolver latency, detecting upstream DNS poisoning and NXDOMAIN tampering, and inspecting raw RFC 8484 JSON response payloads directly from your browser.

methodology.title: RFC 8484 Mechanics & Censorship Detection
methodology.description: Traditional DNS queries over port 53 (UDP/TCP) travel in cleartext, exposing queries to ISP snooping, intermediate transparent proxies, and state-level DNS injection. DNS over HTTPS wraps queries in TLS 1.3 tunnels via HTTPS.
methodology.rfc_desc: Executes HTTP POST/GET requests with 'application/dns-json' and 'application/dns-message' wire formats.
methodology.poisoning_desc: Detects bogons, loopback addresses (127.0.0.1, 10.10.34.x), and private subnet injection in public domain answers.
methodology.zero_log_desc: All HTTPS connections open directly from the browser to Cloudflare, Google, or Quad9 without backend proxies.

meta.title: IP & Identity Leak Scanner | Amin Jamali Systems Lab
meta.description: Real-time client-side identity & privacy leak diagnostic probe. Audit WebRTC socket candidate leaks, test IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack routing, and verify browser timezone synchronization.

header.title: IP & Identity Leak Scanner
header.description: Audit real-time WebRTC socket candidate leaks, test IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack public routing, verify ASN/ISP autonomous system metadata, and detect browser vs. system clock timezone desynchronization directly within your browser.

methodology.title: WebRTC STUN Mechanics & Leak Vectors
methodology.description: Modern browsers employ WebRTC for real-time peer-to-peer audio and video communication. During Interactive Connectivity Establishment (ICE), the browser contacts STUN servers (RFC 5389) to discover public and local routing addresses.
methodology.webrtc_desc: STUN queries bypass HTTP/SOCKS proxies, requesting the router's external NAT endpoint and revealing your true public IP even when connected to standard browser proxy extensions.
methodology.dns_desc: If your upstream DNS traffic does not match your active VPN gateway ASN, your operating system is leaking queries to your local ISP's transparent resolver.
methodology.tz_desc: Ad networks and anti-fraud engines compare Javascript Intl.DateTimeFormat() against the IP geolocation database timezone to detect proxy usage.

controller.score_desc: Evaluated based on WebRTC candidate isolation, public IP anonymity, DNS routing alignment, and timezone synchronization.

webrtc.title: WebRTC ICE Candidate Leak Probe
webrtc.desc_secure: No candidate leak detected. WebRTC STUN requests cleanly match your external public IP address or use masked mDNS candidates.
webrtc.desc_leaked: WebRTC STUN request bypassed your proxy/VPN and exposed your real ISP public IP address.
webrtc.desc_local: WebRTC exposed your local internal network IP (LAN subnet) or host candidate interface.
webrtc.no_candidates: No raw candidate strings leaked from browser socket.

dns.title: Transparent DNS Leak Detector
dns.desc_secure: DNS resolution routes through an encrypted resolver or matches your active gateway ASN.
dns.desc_mismatch: DNS resolver ASN does not match your public IP network routing. Queries may be visible to intermediate providers.

timezone.title: Timezone & Clock Drift Inspector
timezone.desc_match: Browser Intl clock timezone perfectly matches the IP geolocation timezone. Zero entropy drift detected.
timezone.desc_mismatch: System timezone does not align with your IP geolocation. This disparity is frequently flagged by anti-fraud heuristics.

map.title: Geographic Route Visualization
map.approx_notice: Location is estimated from public BGP routing tables with zero device GPS access.

mitigation.title: Identity Hardening & Leak Mitigation
mitigation.subtitle: Recommended defense-in-depth measures to eliminate browser fingerprinting and socket leaks.
mitigation.item1_title: Enforce WebRTC mDNS or Disable Media PeerConnection
mitigation.item1_desc: In Firefox, set 'media.peerconnection.enabled = false' in about:config. In Chromium browsers, install extensions or enable strict mDNS candidate masking to prevent STUN IP discovery.
mitigation.item2_desc: Set your OS or router DNS to 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare) or 9.9.9.9 (Quad9) with strict DoH/DoT encryption to prevent ISP transparent proxy interception.
mitigation.item3_title: Align System Timezone with Gateway Proxy
mitigation.item3_desc: When tunneling through international VPN endpoints, synchronize your operating system clock timezone with the destination server region to defeat entropy checks.
mitigation.item4_title: Disable IPv6 if Using IPv4-Only VPN Tunnels
mitigation.item4_desc: Ensure your VPN client has native IPv6 leak protection enabled, or disable IPv6 on the network adapter if your provider only tunnels IPv4 packets.
